description: Nonempty finite matched slices with strictly increasing nodes. Backward c[i]=(c[i]-c[i-1])/(x[i]-x[i-j]) for j=1..n-1; descending i preserves old column. Evaluate v=c[last], then v=v*(q-node[i])+c[i] in reverse. Constructor validates shape/finiteness/order first; query validates finite q first. Coefficients accessor is immutable.

inverse: At q=0, polynomials x and 0 give identical 0; query does not identify coefficients. Fixed distinct nodes plus complete real coefficients uniquely recover node values through nested evaluation, but coefficients without nodes do not identify original samples and f64 rounding loses information.
